scope: Mika grapple throw horizontal displacement only
reference: Capture current default goblin throw horizontal distance as D0 once before applying this change.
proposal_status: Goblin10/gigas20/mega_goblin15/megamega18 confirmed; other intermediate values remain proposals.
boss_policy: Do not make a boss throwable merely by adding weight. Preserve existing eligibility; boss weight remains unset.
application: Use weight when resolving a successful grapple throw. Preserve existing grapple eligibility, release frame, thrown-body collateral hit behavior, damage and invulnerability.
trajectory_proposal: Keep existing flight duration and arc height initially; scale horizontal travel/velocity to achieve distance. Verify against actual physics. Do not extend hang time simply to double distance.
boundary_policy: Requested distance is unobstructed target distance; existing collision and world boundaries may shorten it.
migration: Never multiply an already adjusted D0 again on reload or repeated patch application. Store original baseline separately.
